# Luau

The Luau VM and compiler (https://github.com/luau-lang/luau), release 0.741
(2d88f9b5facaa9e4ec91247b39ae8251bd49a244), unchanged: the folders `Common`, `Ast`,
`Bytecode`, `Compiler` and `VM`. MIT (`LICENSE.txt`, and `lua_LICENSE.txt` for the
Lua 5.1 parts). Tourne Desktop runs Noctalia's plugins with it (`desktop/host/plugin-runtime.cpp`).

To update: copy those five folders from a newer release over these and change the line above.
